abstract: We study how weakening implicit government guarantee expectations in China’s public credit market affects stock price crash risk. We exploit the March 2014 Chaori default as a shock to rigid-repayment expectations and use a difference-in-differences design. Crash risk falls significantly among firms with public credit-market exposure before the shock, and the result remains after accounting for issuer-level default risk. Adverse earnings news enters stock prices earlier, bond spreads become more informative about subsequent stock returns, and firms with greater pre-shock bond-market exposure experience larger declines in crash risk. Analysts, the media, and online investors provide more downside information. Firms also disclose more bad news, recognize losses sooner, report more promptly, and improve internal-control quality. The decline in crash risk is significantly larger among state-owned enterprises, where expectations of government support were stronger before the shock. The findings identify the credibility of government support as an institutional determinant of cross-market information efficiency and show how market-based credit-risk pricing can strengthen equity-market resilience.
abstract_zh: 本文研究中国公共信贷市场中隐性政府担保预期减弱如何影响股价崩盘风险。我们以2014年3月超日违约作为刚性兑付预期冲击，并采用双重差分设计。冲击前具有公共信贷市场敞口的公司，其崩盘风险显著下降，且在控制发行人层面违约风险后该结果依然成立。负面盈利消息更早进入股价，债券利差对后续股票收益更具信息含量，冲击前债券市场敞口更大的公司崩盘风险下降幅度更大。分析师、媒体和网络投资者提供更多下行信息。公司也披露更多坏消息、更早确认损失、更及时报告并改善内部控制质量。在冲击前政府支持预期更强的国有企业中，崩盘风险下降幅度显著更大。研究结果将政府支持的可信度识别为跨市场信息效率的制度性决定因素，并表明基于市场的信用风险定价能够增强股票市场韧性。

title: When bad news is good news: implicit government guarantees and stock price crash risk
title_zh: 坏消息即好消息：隐性政府担保与股价崩盘风险

abstract: We use an actor-network concept of translation to examine how EU Renewable Energy Community (REC) policy translates into domestic practice under contested sovereignty, infrastructural isolation, and active geopolitical obstruction. Cyprus is a critical, theory-building case: the EU's last fully isolated grid, occupation of part of its territory by a third state, and Turkish obstruction of both gas exploitation and electricity interconnection make the assumptions embedded in EU policy unusually visible. Drawing on policy documents, twelve interviews and participant observation, we trace how the framework fragments as it moves from supranational design to local implementation. The evidence supports two case-derived hypotheses. The first, presupposition-mismatched translation, holds that compliance fails not for want of will or capacity but because the policy as written presupposes a context that does not exist locally, so translation fragments into competing local interpretations. The second, symmetric foreclosure, holds that where one external mechanism blocks both the domestically prioritised energy-security pathway (gas) and the EU-aligned pathway (interconnected renewable generation), competing local obligatory passage points cancel rather than converge. Their joint product is structural decoupling under material constraint, extending Bromley and Powell's means–ends decoupling to cases where the formal-substantive gap is produced by foreclosure of the prescribed means rather than by organizational choice. The argument is not that RECs cannot exist in Cyprus, but that this decarbonisation initiative receives weak domestic backing for geopolitical rather than technical reasons. We draw implications for green-transition initiatives in other peripheral, geopolitically exposed member states and for differentiated EU implementation guidance.
abstract_zh: 我们采用行动者网络理论中的转译概念，考察欧盟可再生能源共同体（REC）政策在主权争议、基础设施孤立和地缘政治主动阻挠的背景下如何转译为国内实践。塞浦路斯是一个具有关键意义的理论建构案例：其电网是欧盟最后一个完全孤立的电网，部分领土被第三国占领，土耳其既阻挠天然气开采也阻挠电力互联，这使得欧盟政策中嵌入的假设异常显见。基于政策文件、十二次访谈和参与式观察，我们追踪该框架如何从超国家设计向地方实施移动时发生碎片化。证据支持两个由案例衍生的假设。第一个是预设错配式转译，即合规失败并非因为缺乏意愿或能力，而是因为政策文本预设了一个当地并不存在的语境，致使转译碎片化为相互竞争的地方解释。第二个是对称性 foreclosure，即在某一外部机制同时阻断国内优先的能源安全路径（天然气）和与欧盟一致的路径（互联的可再生能源发电）的情况下，相互竞争的地方 obligatory passage points 相互抵消而非趋同。二者的共同产物是物质约束下的结构性脱耦，这将 Bromley 和 Powell 的手段—目的脱耦扩展到如下情形：正式—实质差距是由规定手段被 foreclosure 所产生，而非由组织选择所产生。本文的论点并非 REC 在塞浦路斯不可能存在，而是这一脱碳倡议获得薄弱的国内支持，其原因在于地缘政治而非技术。我们为其他边缘性、地缘政治暴露的成员国中的绿色转型倡议以及差异化的欧盟实施指导提炼了启示。
title: Translating EU renewable energy community policy under geopolitical constraint: An actor-network analysis of Cyprus
title_zh: 地缘政治约束下欧盟可再生能源社区政策的转化：塞浦路斯的行动者网络分析

abstract: We show that investment irreversibility plays a prominent role in shaping aggregate fluctuations in a granular economy, characterized by a fat-tailed distribution of non-atomistic firms. Such an economy satisfies two conditions necessary for irreversibility to matter for aggregate fluctuations: idiosyncratic shocks volatile enough to bind the irreversibility constraint cyclically for a mass of large firms, and a failure of the law of large numbers that prevents firm-level fluctuations from washing out in the aggregate. Through both a direct misallocation channel and an indirect general equilibrium channel, irreversibility dampens the volatility of output, investment, and hours while amplifying the volatility of consumption. Eliminating the friction yields a consumption-equivalent welfare gain of 1.83%; however, merely subsidizing capital liquidation reduces welfare by 0.59%, because firms, compensated by the government, do not internalize the aggregate resource losses and therefore over-disinvest.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，投资不可逆性在塑造由非原子型企业厚尾分布所特征的颗粒经济中的总量波动方面发挥着显著作用。这样的经济满足两个条件，这些条件对于不可逆性影响总量波动是必要的：异质性冲击足够剧烈，以至于周期性地使大量大型企业面临不可逆性约束的约束；以及大数定律的失效，这阻止了企业层面的波动在总量中消失。通过直接的错配渠道和间接的一般均衡渠道，不可逆性抑制了产出、投资和工时的波动性，同时放大了消费的波动性。消除这一摩擦可带来相当于消费的1.83%的福利增益；然而，仅仅补贴资本清算会降低福利0.59%，因为企业在政府补偿下并未内部化总量资源损失，从而过度撤资。
title: Investment irreversibility in a granular world
title_zh: 颗粒世界中的投资不可逆性

abstract: We study the local effects of trade exposure and immigration on voting behavior in France over the period 1988–2022. We construct a novel measure of anti-globalization voting that combines the policy positions expressed in presidential candidates’ manifestos with local electoral outcomes. We find that greater exposure to import competition increases anti-globalization voting, whereas export exposure reduces it, consistent with their contrasting effects on French local employment. Immigration also increases anti-globalization voting. Finally, the political effects of imports depend on their composition. While imports of final goods increase anti-globalization voting, imports of intermediate goods reduce support for anti-globalization ideas. This asymmetric effect is consistent with the fact that final goods imports generate employment losses in regions specialized in import-competing industries, whereas intermediate goods imports tend to support domestic production and employment within global value chains.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了1988—2022年间贸易暴露与移民对法国投票行为的局部影响。我们构建了一种新的反全球化投票度量，将总统候选人竞选纲领中表达的政策立场与地方选举结果相结合。我们发现，进口竞争暴露程度越高，反全球化投票越多，而出口暴露则会减少反全球化投票，这与二者对法国地方就业的相反影响相一致。移民同样会增加反全球化投票。最后，进口的政治效应取决于其构成。最终品进口会增加反全球化投票，而中间品进口则会降低对反全球化理念的支持。这种非对称效应与以下事实相一致：最终品进口会在专业化于进口竞争产业的地区造成就业损失，而中间品进口往往在全球价值链内支撑国内生产与就业。
title: Does trade exposure explain anti-globalization votes?
title_zh: 贸易暴露能否解释反全球化投票？

abstract: This study examines whether proximity to digital technology markets promotes manufacturing electrification, measured as an increase in the electricity share of firms’ energy use. Using data from the Qichacha Business Information Platform for 2007–2020, we identify digital firms and construct a firm-level measure of digital proximity. Using an instrumental-variable strategy, we find that greater digital proximity significantly promotes firm electrification. This effect operates through increased investment in external digital technology and electricity-biased technical change, and is more pronounced in regions with larger markets and higher electricity reliability. Industry heterogeneity analysis further shows that the effect is concentrated in equipment manufacturing, textiles and light manufacturing, and chemical products, and is more pronounced in industries with greater production complexity, technology intensity, and digital dependence. Extending the analysis to the power generation mix, we find that greater digital proximity is positively associated with the share of clean power generation in total power generation. These findings link digital proximity to firm electrification on the demand side and to a cleaner power generation mix on the supply side, offering new evidence on the relationship between the digital economy and the energy transition.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了靠近数字技术市场是否促进制造业电气化，并以企业能源使用中电力份额的增加来衡量电气化程度。利用企查查商业信息平台2007—2020年的数据，我们识别数字企业并构建企业层面的数字邻近度指标。采用工具变量策略，我们发现更高的数字邻近度显著促进企业电气化。这一效应通过增加外部数字技术投资和电力偏向型技术变革发挥作用，并且在市场规模更大、供电可靠性更高的地区更为明显。行业异质性分析进一步表明，该效应集中于装备制造、纺织与轻工制造以及化工产品行业，并在生产复杂度更高、技术强度更大和数字依赖度更高的行业中更为明显。将分析扩展至发电结构，我们发现更高的数字邻近度与清洁发电在总发电量中的份额呈正相关。这些发现将需求侧的数字邻近度与企业电气化联系起来，并将供给侧的数字邻近度与更清洁的发电结构联系起来，为数字经济与能源转型之间的关系提供了新的证据。
title: Electrifying the factory and beyond: The impact of digital proximity on energy transition
title_zh: 工厂电气化及其延伸：数字邻近性对能源转型的影响

abstract: Climate change is intensifying temperature extremes worldwide and reshaping electricity demand, yet the impacts of extreme cold remain underexplored, particularly in regions without centralized heating. Using China as a large, climatically diverse case with substantial regional, infrastructural, and income-level heterogeneity, we analyze over two decades of data from more than 300,000 urban households to estimate nonlinear temperature–electricity responses and their regional and income heterogeneity. Results indicate that extreme temperatures significantly increase electricity demand in southern China, with cold extremes exerting a markedly stronger effect than heat extremes, while northern households under centralized heating display minimal sensitivity. Income inequalities exacerbate adaptation challenges, disproportionately affecting low-income households. Coupling these estimates with CMIP6 climate projections based on multi-year averages over 2090–2099, we find that national electricity demand could rise by up to 15.0%, while demand in southern China may increase by as much as 65.3%, driven predominantly by intensifying cold extremes, with low-income households bearing the greatest burden. These results demonstrate that cold-related risks constitute an overlooked but globally relevant driver of future electricity demand and provide evidence to inform climate-resilient and equitable adaptation strategies across regions facing diverse climatic and institutional conditions.
abstract_zh: 气候变化正在加剧全球范围内的极端气温并重塑电力需求，但极端寒冷的影响仍未得到充分研究，尤其是在缺乏集中供暖的地区。本文以中国作为气候多样、在区域、基础设施和收入水平上具有显著异质性的大型案例，分析来自30多万城市家庭二十余年的数据，估计气温—电力响应的非线性特征及其区域和收入异质性。结果表明，极端气温显著推高中国南方地区的电力需求，其中极端寒冷的影响明显强于极端高温，而集中供暖条件下的北方家庭则表现出极低的敏感性。收入不平等加剧了适应挑战，对低收入家庭的影响尤为严重。将这些估计结果与基于2090—2099年多年平均值的CMIP6气候预估相结合，我们发现全国电力需求可能上升至多15.0%，而中国南方地区的需求可能增加高达65.3%，其主要驱动因素是日益加剧的极端寒冷，且低收入家庭承受的负担最重。这些结果表明，寒冷相关风险是未来电力需求中一个被忽视但具有全球相关性的驱动因素，并为面临多样气候和制度条件的各地区制定气候韧性和公平的适应策略提供了证据。

title: Cold shocks in a warming world: Regional disparities in household climate adaptation and electricity demand
title_zh: 变暖世界中的寒潮冲击：家庭气候适应与电力需求的区域差异

abstract: This study investigates the impact of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) news sentiment on the premium of green financial instruments. This study contributes by providing systematic evidence on how ESG news sentiment functions as a form of soft information in green bond pricing. Using data from green bonds issued by Chinese A-share listed companies from 2016 to 2023, we employ a two-way fixed effects model to examine the effect of ESG news sentiment on credit spreads. Our analysis reveals that positive ESG news sentiment significantly compresses green bond credit spreads, and that green finance policies strengthen this effect. These findings offer new insights into the role of ESG narratives in the green finance market and provide implications for constructing a consistent review system for green information disclosure and ESG media coverage.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察环境、社会与治理（ESG）新闻情绪对绿色金融工具溢价的影响。本研究通过提供关于ESG新闻情绪如何作为软信息在绿色债券定价中发挥作用的系统性证据作出贡献。使用2016年至2023年中国A股上市公司发行的绿色债券数据，我们采用双向固定效应模型考察ESG新闻情绪对信用利差的影响。我们的分析表明，积极的ESG新闻情绪显著压缩绿色债券信用利差，且绿色金融政策强化了这一效应。这些发现为ESG叙事在绿色金融市场中的作用提供了新见解，并为构建绿色信息披露和ESG媒体报道的一致审查体系提供了启示。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: The impact of ESG news sentiment on green bond credit spreads: The role of institutional environment
title_zh: ESG新闻情绪对绿色债券信用利差的影响：制度环境的作用

abstract: This article examines how Japan’s three-decade period of ultra-easy monetary policy interacted with persistently low inflation. Using a structural vector autoregressive model informed by Keynesian cost-push and conflict-inflation theories and long-run quarterly data for 1991–2023, the analysis identifies corporate price markups and bank lending as important drivers of inflation. The results also reveal a distinctive form of conflict inflation: increases in wage costs did not necessarily translate into higher prices, while periods of cost pass-through were accompanied by corresponding wage increases. Amongst six monetary policy instruments, only monetary-base expansion had an indirect effect on inflation through its positive effect on bank lending. Japan’s ultra-easy monetary policy therefore contributed to preventing deflation primarily by supporting bank lending rather than through direct effects on inflation. The findings highlight the importance of considering the interaction amongst firms’ pricing power, credit conditions, and wage formation when assessing inflation dynamics and monetary policy effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 本文考察日本长达三十年的超宽松货币政策如何与持续低通胀相互作用。基于凯恩斯主义成本推动与冲突通胀理论构建结构向量自回归模型，并采用1991—2023年长期季度数据，分析识别出企业价格加成和银行信贷是通胀的重要驱动因素。结果还揭示了一种独特的冲突通胀形式：工资成本上升未必转化为更高价格，而成本转嫁时期则伴随相应的工资上涨。在六种货币政策工具中，只有基础货币扩张通过其对银行信贷的正向效应间接影响通胀。因此，日本的超宽松货币政策主要通过支持银行信贷而非直接作用于通胀来防止通缩。研究结论强调，在评估通胀动态与货币政策有效性时，需考虑企业定价能力、信贷条件与工资形成之间的相互作用。
title: Japan’s Low Inflation: A Structural VAR Analysis of Cost-Push Pricing and Bank Lending over Three Decades
title_zh: 日本低通胀：三十年来成本推动定价与银行信贷的结构向量自回归分析

abstract: Global supply chain pressures have intensified amid geopolitical tensions and trade frictions, exposing firms to greater operational and financial uncertainty. Using a comprehensive panel of Chinese listed manufacturing firms, this study examines whether and how global supply chain pressures affect firms’ ex-post risk-taking. Exploiting cross-sectional variation in firms’ exposure to supply chain pressures, we find a positive relation between supply chain pressures and ex-post risk-taking, and the impact of supply chain pressures is greater for firms with higher exposure. The result is robust to alternative measures of supply chain exposure and risk-taking and to a range of endogeneity concerns. Mechanism analysis shows that supply chain pressures lower supply chain concentration, reduce operational efficiency, erode firm value, and heighten stock price crash risk, thereby increasing firms’ subsequent risk-taking. Overall, the findings identify global supply chain pressures as an important source of corporate risk-taking and show how supply-side disruptions can amplify firms’ financial fragility.
abstract_zh: 全球供应链压力在地缘政治紧张与贸易摩擦的背景下不断加剧，使企业面临更大的运营与财务不确定性。本文基于中国制造业上市公司综合面板数据，考察全球供应链压力是否以及如何影响企业的事后风险承担。利用企业在供应链压力暴露程度上的横截面差异，我们发现供应链压力与企业事后风险承担之间存在正相关关系，且对于暴露程度更高的企业，供应链压力的影响更大。该结果在供应链暴露与风险承担的替代度量以及一系列内生性问题下均保持稳健。机制分析表明，供应链压力会降低供应链集中度、降低运营效率、侵蚀企业价值并加剧股价崩盘风险，从而增加企业后续的风险承担。总体而言，本文发现全球供应链压力是企业风险承担的重要来源，并揭示了供给侧冲击如何放大企业的财务脆弱性。

title: Global Supply Chain Disruptions and Corporate Risk-Taking: Evidence from China*
title_zh: 全球供应链中断与企业风险承担：来自中国的证据

abstract: Direct-to-consumer advertising is pervasive in US healthcare markets, but little evidence exists on the effects of advertising by hospitals, second only to drug manufacturers in medical marketing. Advertising may help facilities increase market share by stealing existing patients, expanding the market for hospital care, or both. Regardless, it has important public finance implications due to the large sums of taxpayer funds spent by federal and state governments to subsidize hospital operations and finance care through public insurance programs. This paper provides the first causal evidence on the market expansion effects of hospital advertising. To obtain causal estimates, we leverage the fact that spikes in political advertising significantly crowd out hospital advertising in the same market, motivating an instrumental variables design. Using claims data on the universe of Traditional Medicare beneficiaries, we find that advertising expands aggregate patient volume and spending on inpatient care - though to a modest degree (implied elasticities are 0.06 and 0.05, respectively). Although the overall effect of advertising on hospital outpatient care is small and imprecise, for-profit hospitals obtain higher outpatient Medicare volume and revenue.
abstract_zh: 直接面向消费者的广告在美国医疗保健市场无处不在，但关于医院广告效果的证据却很少，而医院在医疗营销中的支出仅次于药品制造商。广告可能通过吸引现有患者、扩大医院护理市场或两者兼而有之，帮助医疗机构增加市场份额。无论如何，由于联邦和州政府花费大量纳税人资金补贴医院运营并通过公共保险项目资助医疗护理，这具有重要的公共财政影响。本文提供了关于医院广告市场扩张效应的首个因果证据。为获得因果估计，我们利用政治广告的激增会显著挤占同一市场中医院广告这一事实，构建工具变量设计。使用覆盖传统 Medicare 全体受益人的理赔数据，我们发现广告扩大了总体患者量和住院护理支出——尽管程度有限（隐含弹性分别为 0.06 和 0.05）。尽管广告对医院门诊护理的总体效应较小且不精确，但营利性医院获得了更高的门诊 Medicare 量和收入。
title: Does advertising expand the market for hospital services? Evidence from Medicare
title_zh: 广告是否扩大了医院服务市场？来自Medicare的证据

abstract: We evaluated both the demand for and impact of a prevention tool against malaria that requires repeated purchase and overcomes the limits of mosquito bed nets. We used a randomized experiment to examine the effects of subsidies for a mosquito repellent ointment that protects against mosquito bites and malaria on product use and malaria cases in Burkina Faso. Around 3100 households were randomly allocated to one of the three experimental groups defined by level of subsidy: 0, 50 or 100%. Subsidies strongly and significantly increase the probability of acquiring a jar of mosquito repellent ointment and using it regularly during the rainy season. We find no substitution with bed nets, but a strong effect on the use of mosquito coils. The treatment effects on usage are heterogeneous, including more positive outcomes for young children as reported by their caregiver. The impact on use continues even after the end of the subsidy, with effects on demand and willingness to pay elicited through a Becker–DeGroot–Marschak approach eight months after the end of the intervention. Our intervention induces a significant reduction in declared malaria occurrence during the rainy season, but no effect at the very end of the rainy season when blood tests were taken. The seemingly discrepancy will be partly explained by timing and sample size.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了一种需要重复购买且克服了蚊帐局限性的疟疾预防工具的需求与影响。我们通过随机实验考察了在布基纳法索，对一种可防止蚊虫叮咬和疟疾的驱蚊软膏提供补贴对产品使用和疟疾病例的影响。约3100户家庭被随机分配到按补贴水平划分的三个实验组之一：0、50%或100%。补贴强烈且显著地提高了在雨季获取一罐驱蚊软膏并定期使用的概率。我们未发现与蚊帐之间存在替代关系，但发现对蚊香使用有强烈影响。使用方面的处理效应具有异质性，包括照护者报告的幼儿更为积极的结果。对使用的影响在补贴结束后仍持续存在，在干预结束八个月后通过Becker–DeGroot–Marschak方法引出的需求和支付意愿方面仍有影响。我们的干预显著降低了雨季期间自报的疟疾发生，但在雨季即将结束时进行血液检测时没有影响。这一表面上的差异将部分由时间安排和样本量来解释。
title: Subsidies for innovative technology adoption: Experimental evidence on malaria in Burkina Faso
title_zh: 创新技术采用补贴：布基纳法索疟疾的实验证据

abstract: Heterogeneous-agent models with multiple decisions face a computational dilemma. Joint optimization over all choices is slow; strong separability restrictions speed computation but rule out economically interesting interactions. I introduce Sequential EGM (EGM n ), which eases this tension by decomposing the problem into sequential stages so that each stage can exploit the Endogenous Grid Method’s closed-form inversion, chaining speed gains across decisions wherever separable utility or an invertible transition permits it. The resulting curvilinear grids require interpolation that respects their structure, so I develop ENGINE (ENdogenous Grid INterpolation and Extrapolation), which exploits the index structure inherited from exogenous grids, with no construction step and no triangulation. In the canonical liquid-illiquid household block, EGM n solves an order of magnitude faster than the nested method in serial and 3.7 to 7.9 times faster at sixteen threads. Replacing existing curvilinear interpolation with ENGINE cuts full-solve time 2.8- to 4.5-fold at matched accuracy.
abstract_zh: 具有多重决策的异质性主体模型面临计算困境。对所有选择进行联合优化速度缓慢；强可分性限制虽能加速计算，却排除了具有经济意义的交互作用。本文引入序贯EGM（EGM n），通过将问题分解为序贯阶段来缓解这一张力，使每个阶段都能利用内生网格法的闭式反演，在可分效用或可逆转移允许之处将速度收益跨决策串联。由此产生的曲线网格需要尊重其结构的插值方法，因此我开发了ENGINE（内生网格插值与外推），该方法利用继承自外生网格的索引结构，无需构建步骤，也无需三角剖分。在典型的流动性—非流动性家庭模块中，EGM n在串行计算下比嵌套方法快一个数量级，在十六线程下快3.7至7.9倍。以ENGINE替代现有曲线插值，在匹配精度下将完整求解时间缩短2.8至4.5倍。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: The Sequential Endogenous Grid Method
title_zh: 序贯内生网格法

abstract: Modern information and communication technologies have opened new possibilities in the way people live and work. This study examines the impact of Colombia’s 2019 mandate that increased residential download speeds on the likelihood of employment among prime-working-age women. Using nationally representative data from 2012 to 2024, we employ an event-study design and complementary treatment-effect estimators under unconfoundedness. Our results indicate that women living in regions exposed to the largest improvements in residential internet speed are more likely to work, with effects persisting throughout the post-reform period, including pandemic and post-pandemic years. We also provide suggestive evidence that improvements in internet quality are associated with lower housework participation and greater use of online banking, online purchasing, online job search and online sales. While these mechanisms do not establish a definitive behavioural pathway, they are consistent with the view that higher-quality internet may reduce household-management costs and facilitate women’s labour market participation.
title: Need for speed: internet access and women’s employment in Colombia
title_zh: 速度需求：哥伦比亚的互联网接入与女性就业

abstract: The celebrated Efficiency-Adjusted Deferred Acceptance mechanism (EADA) improves the efficiency of the DA algorithm via consented priority violations. Notwithstanding its many merits, we show that EADA can improve only two students when an alternative mechanism that Pareto-dominates DA could benefit all but one student. This shortfall in the number of students improved is not exclusive of EADA but extends to all setwise minimally unstable mechanisms, i.e. those that generate a set of blocking pairs that is never a strict superset of that of another mechanism. The incompatibility between number of students improved and minimal instability disappears when blocking pairs are compared cardinally rather than by set inclusion. In some problems, EADA can be doubly dominated: improving fewer students while generating more blocking pairs.
abstract_zh: 著名的效率调整延迟接受机制（EADA）通过经同意的优先权违反提升了DA算法的效率。尽管其优点众多，我们表明，当一种帕累托优于DA的替代机制能够使除一名学生之外的所有学生受益时，EADA只能改善两名学生。这种在受改善学生数量上的不足并非EADA所独有，而是扩展到所有集合意义上最小不稳定机制，即那些所产生的阻塞对集合永远不是另一机制阻塞对集合的严格超集的机制。当阻塞对以基数方式而非集合包含方式进行比较时，受改善学生数量与最小不稳定之间的不相容性便消失了。在某些问题中，EADA可能被双重支配：改善更少的学生，同时产生更多的阻塞对。
title: The trade-off between minimal instability and larger improvements over deferred acceptance
title_zh: 最小不稳定与优于延迟接受机制的较大改进之间的权衡

abstract: We study whether administrative borrower classification affects foreign-currency (FX) credit. In Peru, a regulatory debt threshold generates a fuzzy regression-discontinuity design. Crossing the threshold sharply increases medium-enterprise classification. Using a constant-exchange-rate running variable and controlling for predetermined FX exposure, induced reclassification raises the probability of holding FX credit after twelve months by about 7 percentage points ( p = 0.057 ). Density tests do not reject continuity, and the result is robust to controlling for predetermined banking relationships. Effects on FX shares and currency-specific loan amounts remain imprecise. The main result concerns access to FX credit.
abstract_zh: 我们研究行政性借款人分类是否影响外币（FX）信贷。在秘鲁，一个监管债务阈值产生了模糊断点回归设计。跨越该阈值会显著提高中型企业分类。使用固定汇率的驱动变量并控制预先存在的外币敞口，由分类引致的企业重新分类使十二个月后持有外币信贷的概率提高约7个百分点（p = 0.057）。密度检验未拒绝连续性，且该结果在控制预先存在的银企关系后依然稳健。对外币份额和特定币种贷款金额的影响仍不精确。主要结果涉及外币信贷的可获得性。
title: Borrower classification and access to foreign-currency credit: Evidence from a regulatory threshold
title_zh: 借款人分类与外币信贷获取：来自监管阈值的证据

abstract: With two individuals and unrestricted rational preferences, Nash implementation of Pareto efficiency forces dictatorship (Hurwicz and Schmeidler, 1978; Maskin, 1999). We show that this conclusion needs very little rationality. On any domain containing two families of states—blocking and polarization—a behaviorally efficient social choice rule is Nash implementable if and only if it equals, at every state, one fixed individual’s choice from the grand menu. The rational domain recovers the classical theorem, while all WARP-violating choice profiles qualify with at least four alternatives. Two-person implementation of efficiency is dictatorial with this much rationality, and it needs no more.
abstract_zh: 在两个个体且理性偏好不受限制的条件下，帕累托效率的纳什实施必然导致独裁（Hurwicz and Schmeidler, 1978; Maskin, 1999）。我们表明，这一结论所需理性程度极低。在任何包含两类状态——阻塞与极化——的域上，一个行为有效的社会选择规则是纳什可实施的，当且仅当它在每个状态上都等于某一固定个体从大菜单中的选择。理性域可还原经典定理，而所有违反WARP的选择剖面在至少四个备选方案下均满足条件。两人效率实施在如此理性程度下是独裁的，且无需更多理性。
title: Maskin’s two-person impossibility without rationality
title_zh: Maskin无理性条件下的两人不可能性

abstract: What explains Southeast Asia's persistent resistance to decarbonization despite falling renewable costs and growing climate commitments? While existing literature points to carbon lock-in through technological and institutional dynamics, it under-theorizes how financial and contractual arrangements — especially in emerging economies — interact to stabilize and reinforce fossil fuel dependence across contexts. We develop a financial–contractual lock-in framework that conceptualizes how project-level funding structures and long-term contractual commitments aggregate into system-level inertia. Applying this framework across five major Southeast Asian power systems (Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, and the Philippines), we trace how these mechanisms convert private investment protections into public fiscal rigidity, aligning state and investor interests around continued fossil fuel operation. Our findings reveal that the tractability of exit depends on creditor reachability, counterparty coordination, residual financial exposure, and state fiscal or institutional restructuring capacity. Where market liberalization has advanced, lock-in is relocated rather than removed: legacy obligations are socialized through consumer charges rather than the sovereign balance sheet, and renegotiation is complicated by the dispersal of contractual obligations across multiple private counterparties, even as forward-looking fossil investment faces genuine market discipline. Gas risks replicating coal's bankability logic where states extend comparable risk mitigation, making a second generation of lock-in a policy choice rather than an inevitability. The framework offers a transferable diagnostic lens for scholars examining fiscal and legal dimensions of fossil fuel persistence beyond these cases.
abstract_zh: 尽管可再生能源成本不断下降且气候承诺日益增强，是什么解释了东南亚对脱碳的持续抵制？现有文献指出技术与制度动态导致的碳锁定，但对金融与合同安排——尤其是在新兴经济体中——如何相互作用以在不同情境下稳定并强化化石燃料依赖的理论化不足。我们构建了一个金融—合同锁定框架，将项目层面的融资结构与长期合同承诺如何聚合为系统层面的惯性加以概念化。将该框架应用于东南亚五大电力系统（印度尼西亚、马来西亚、泰国、越南和菲律宾），我们追踪这些机制如何将私人投资保护转化为公共财政刚性，使国家与投资者利益围绕化石燃料的持续运营趋于一致。我们的研究发现表明，退出的可处理性取决于债权人可触及性、交易对手协调、剩余金融敞口以及国家财政或制度重组能力。在市场自由化已推进的地方，锁定是被转移而非消除：遗留义务通过消费者收费而非主权资产负债表被社会化，且重新谈判因合同义务分散于多个私人交易对手而变得复杂，即便前瞻性化石投资面临真正的市场约束。在國家提供可比风险缓释的情况下，天然气风险可能复制煤炭的可融资性逻辑，使第二代锁定成为政策选择而非不可避免。该框架为研究这些案例之外化石燃料持续存在的财政与法律维度的学者提供了一个可迁移的诊断视角。
title: Rethinking carbon lock-in: Financial and contractual drivers in Southeast Asian power systems
title_zh: 重新思考碳锁定：东南亚电力系统中的金融与合同驱动因素

abstract: Narrower international income gaps are usually read as evidence that poorer economies are catching up. Yet economies that began ahead can also narrow those gaps by losing relative ground. A variance decomposition shows that economies initially above the mean account for close to half of gross compression since 1990, consistently across horizons from one to ten years. Compression is concentrated in both income tails. Falling back need not mean becoming poorer. Most economies contributing from above continue to grow at longer horizons. Slower capital deepening and productivity growth accompany these episodes. Historical IMF forecasts add evidence on persistence. Downgrades that survive successive vintages predict weaker subsequent growth, and cumulative revisions to expected output levels are more informative than terminal-growth revisions. A positive fitted trajectory gap is also associated with subsequent banking distress; debt and sovereign-default correlations are less stable. Global convergence can therefore combine successful catch-up with persistent weaknesses among economies previously ahead, with different implications for growth analysis and policy.
abstract_zh: 国际收入差距缩小通常被解读为较贫穷经济体正在追赶的证据。然而，原本领先的经济体也可能通过相对失势来缩小这些差距。一项方差分解显示，自1990年以来，初始高于均值的经济体贡献了总压缩量的近一半，且在一年至十年的各时间跨度上均保持一致。压缩集中在收入分布的两端。回落并不一定意味着变得更贫穷。多数从上方贡献压缩的经济体在较长时间跨度上仍持续增长。这些情形伴随着资本深化和生产率增长的放缓。国际货币基金组织的历史预测为持续性提供了额外证据。历经多次预测版本仍存续的下调预测预示着随后更弱的增长，而对预期产出水平的累积修正比终端增长修正更具信息含量。正向的拟合轨迹差距也与随后的银行业困境相关；债务与主权违约的相关性则较不稳定。因此，全球趋同可能同时包含成功的追赶与先前领先经济体的持续疲弱，这对增长分析和政策具有不同含义。
title: Convergence from Above: When Global Catch-Up Reflects Falling Back
title_zh: 从上方趋同：当全球追赶反映为回落

abstract: Some people want to ban other people’s actions even when there are no obvious externalities. We argue that bans can arise endogenously as a consequence of social norm conformity: instead of adjusting one’s own behavior, another way to conform one’s behavior is to change the behavior of others. Assuming that a majority can ban the actions of others, the model makes testable predictions about which actions will be banned, as well as about the stable social norm. Moreover, we show that, with sufficiently strong norm conformism, bans are incommensurable in the sense that there is no majority willing to abandon the bans and tax the minority’s actions instead.
abstract_zh: 有些人希望禁止他人的行为，即使不存在明显的外部性。我们认为，禁令可以作为社会规范从众的结果而内生出现：与其调整自身行为，遵从规范的另一种方式是改变他人的行为。假设多数人能够禁止他人的行为，该模型对哪些行为将被禁止以及稳定的社会规范作出了可检验的预测。此外，我们表明，在规范从众足够强的情况下，禁令具有不可通约性，即不存在愿意放弃禁令并转而对少数人的行为征税的多数。
title: Why people ban others’ actions: A norm conformism hypothesis
title_zh: 为什么人们禁止他人的行为：一种规范从众假说

abstract: This paper examines how occupational artificial intelligence (AI) exposure is associated with formal volunteering and how much of this association reflects broader occupational structure. The analysis links an occupation-level measure of potential large language model exposure to the 2017, 2019, 2021, and 2023 U.S. Current Population Survey Volunteering and Civic Life Supplement. A one-standard-deviation increase in AI exposure is associated with a 2.26-percentage-point higher probability of formal volunteering. However, the coefficient falls by about 60% with broad occupation-group fixed effects and is essentially zero after controlling for occupational education, wages, prestige, and socioeconomic status. The association is already present before generative AI diffusion and does not strengthen in 2023 relative to 2019. A stacked comparison shows a significantly stronger association for formal volunteering than for informal neighbour helping. Overall, the results indicate that the observed association between occupational AI exposure and formal volunteering largely reflects pre-existing occupational structure rather than an effect of AI adoption.
title: Occupational AI exposure and formal volunteering: the role of occupational structure
title_zh: 职业人工智能暴露与正式志愿服务：职业结构的作用

abstract_status: 摘要暂未公开，系统将自动重试
title: Corrigendum to: “How economic growth, renewable electricity and natural resources contribute to CO2 emissions?” [Energy Pol. 113, (2018), 356-367]
title_zh: 更正：“经济增长、可再生电力与自然资源如何影响二氧化碳排放？”[Energy Pol. 113, (2018), 356-367]

abstract: The emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) has heightened interest in personalizing computer assisted learning (CAL) programs to tailor their instruction to individual students. Despite the proliferation of AI-driven CAL programs, evidence for their effectiveness remains limited. We present findings from a field experiment in rural China examining whether an AI-driven personalized CAL program improves student achievement. We randomly assign 8647 students from 315 primary school classes to one of three treatment arms: (i) AI-CAL, (ii) non-personalized CAL (active control), and (iii) non-CAL educational activities (pure control). Results indicate that AI-CAL does not significantly improve achievement, with estimates precise enough to rule out non-trivial positive effects. This finding holds across the difficulty of assessment items and across the baseline achievement of students. If anything, AI-CAL might be less effective than non-personalized CAL for students in the middle tercile of baseline achievement. These findings call for caution when scaling AI-driven educational technologies.
abstract_zh: 人工智能的出现激发了人们对个性化计算机辅助学习（CAL）项目的更大兴趣，以期根据学生个体情况调整教学。尽管人工智能驱动的CAL项目不断增多，但其有效性的证据仍然有限。我们呈现了一项在中国农村开展的实地实验研究结果，考察人工智能驱动的个性化CAL项目是否能提高学生成绩。我们将来自315个小学班级的8647名学生随机分配到三种处理组之一：（i）AI-CAL，（ii）非个性化CAL（主动对照），以及（iii）非CAL教育活动（纯对照）。结果表明，AI-CAL并未显著提高成绩，估计结果足够精确，可以排除非平凡的正向效应。这一发现适用于不同难度的评估题目以及不同基线成绩的学生。如果说有什么不同的话，对于基线成绩处于中间三分之一的学生而言，AI-CAL可能不如非个性化CAL有效。这些发现呼吁在推广人工智能驱动的教育技术时保持谨慎。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Putting AI to the test: Evidence from a large-scale RCT in rural China
title_zh: 让人工智能接受检验：来自中国农村大规模随机对照试验的证据

abstract: This paper examines the impact of paid migrant home care on elderly health outcomes in Italy. The results show that an increase in migrants’ presence reduces both the frequency and duration of hospitalisations. Specifically, a 1 percentage-point increase in the migrant-to-elderly ratio leads to a decline in long-term and rehabilitation inpatient (LRI) admissions of 118 cases per 100,000 elders, with no measurable effect on acute inpatient stays. There is also a reduction in the average length of stay of 0.141 days, rising to 0.956 days for LRI cases. These effects are driven by diagnoses related to traumatic injuries, musculoskeletal, and genitourinary conditions — areas closely linked to home mobility and care management. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that the average annual increase of 1.3 percentage points in the migrant-to-elderly ratio observed during the study period corresponds to an 8% reduction in elderly LRI hospitalisation costs, equivalent to 252.3 million euros.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利有偿移民家庭护理对老年人健康结果的影响。结果表明，移民存在的增加同时降低了住院的频率和持续时间。具体而言，移民与老年人比例每增加1个百分点，长期及康复住院（LRI）入院人数每10万名老年人减少118例，而对急性住院未见可测量的影响。平均住院时长也减少了0.141天，对于LRI病例则升至0.956天。这些效应主要由与创伤性损伤、肌肉骨骼及泌尿生殖系统疾病相关的诊断所驱动——这些领域与家庭活动能力和护理管理密切相关。粗略估算表明，研究期间观察到的移民与老年人比例年均增加1.3个百分点，对应老年人LRI住院成本降低8%，相当于2.523亿欧元。
title: The role of immigrant caregivers in improving the welfare of elders and reducing public health costs
title_zh: 移民护理人员在改善老年人福利和降低公共卫生成本中的作用

abstract: Despite growing evidence on the economic role of rural digitalization, less is known about how rural e-commerce relates to income among low-income rural households (LRHs). We use survey data from 503 villages in China to provide village-level evidence on the association between rural e-commerce development and the average income of LRHs. Average income among LRHs tends to be higher in villages where rural e-commerce is more developed, while some specifications also point to smaller within-village income gaps. This association appears more evident in western China and in villages with better transport links and basic infrastructure. The association also differs across local governance conditions. The association is more pronounced where village cadres have stronger administrative capacity, village collective economies are more developed, and cooperative-based benefit-sharing arrangements are in place. Internet penetration also appears to matter. The association is stronger as internet access rises from low to moderate levels, but becomes weaker once basic connectivity is widely established. Our results are consistent with a pro-poor dimension of rural e-commerce under supportive local conditions. In particular, higher income among LRHs is more likely where digital access is complemented by infrastructure, governance capacity, and collective arrangements that help disadvantaged households connect to market opportunities.
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Rural E-Commerce, village governance, and income among low-income rural households: evidence from China
title_zh: 农村电子商务、村庄治理与农村低收入家庭收入：来自中国的证据

abstract: The West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil futures market plays an important role in oil-price discovery and risk management, making accurate forecasts of downside tail risk valuable to market participants. Using daily WTI futures data from January 2000 to December 2025, this paper examines how the use of historical information affects downside Value at Risk (VaR) forecasting. We develop a unified Conditional Autoregressive Value at Risk (CAViaR) framework that jointly considers four aspects of the memory structure, which are window design, bandwidth length, kernel weighting, and the CAViaR updating specification. Together, these choices determine how historical oil-market information is retained, weighted, discounted, and updated. Our paper differs from related studies by exploring which memory structures are more informative for crude-oil tail-risk forecasting under different market conditions. The full-sample evidence identifies a set of superior forecasting structures, characterized by expanding windows, non-truncated kernel weighting, medium-to-long bandwidths, and asymmetric updating dynamics. Relative to conventional rolling-window, uniformly weighted CAViaR benchmarks, these structures deliver relatively more stable gains at the 95% VaR level, whereas gains at the 99% level are more concentrated in particular oil-market states. The findings provide useful implications for VaR-based downside risk management in the WTI crude oil futures market.
abstract_zh: 西德克萨斯中质原油（WTI）期货市场在石油价格发现与风险管理中发挥着重要作用，因此对下行尾部风险的准确预测对市场参与者具有重要价值。本文使用2000年1月至2025年12月的WTI期货日度数据，考察历史信息的使用方式如何影响下行风险价值（VaR）预测。我们构建了一个统一的条件自回归风险价值（CAViaR）框架，该框架同时考虑记忆结构的四个方面，即窗口设计、带宽长度、核加权以及CAViaR更新设定。这些选择共同决定了历史石油市场信息如何被保留、加权、折现和更新。本文与相关研究的不同之处在于，探讨在不同市场状态下哪些记忆结构对原油尾部风险预测更具信息含量。全样本证据识别出一组占优的预测结构，其特征为扩展窗口、非截断核加权、中长带宽以及非对称更新动态。相对于传统的滚动窗口、等权重的CAViaR基准，这些结构在95% VaR水平上带来相对更稳定的改进，而在99%水平上的改进则更集中于特定的石油市场状态。研究结论为WTI原油期货市场中基于VaR的下行风险管理提供了有益启示。
title: The role of memory structure in tail risk forecasting for WTI crude oil futures
title_zh: 记忆结构在WTI原油期货尾部风险预测中的作用

abstract: We examine the impact of a carbon tax on consumer choices via a large-scale online randomized controlled trial. Higher taxes generally reduce the demand for high-carbon goods. Compared to an import tax, a carbon tax reduces demand when the tax is zero (i.e., announced but not levied) but leads to relatively higher demand for high-carbon goods when a positive tax is introduced. This difference in demand responses, despite identical prices, is concentrated among climate-concerned consumers. Our findings suggest that carbon taxes can crowd out the effect of climate concerns on consumer choices, with important implications for policy.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项大规模在线随机对照试验考察碳税对消费者选择的影响。一般而言，较高的税负会降低对高碳商品的需求。与进口税相比，碳税在税率零时（即已宣布但未征收）会降低需求，但在引入正税率时会导致对高碳商品相对更高的需求。尽管价格相同，这种需求反应的差异集中于关注气候的消费者。我们的发现表明，碳税可能挤出气候关注对消费者选择的影响，这对政策具有重要启示。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: Carbon taxes crowd out low-carbon choices: Evidence from a consumer experiment
title_zh: 碳税挤出低碳选择：来自消费者实验的证据

abstract: Public debt is at or near record highs across the OECD, increasing the pressure on governments to restore fiscal sustainability over time. This column draws on new cross-country evidence showing that the output costs of fiscal consolidation are modest and short-lived on average, and that lasting scars are hard to detect. But averages conceal a critical asymmetry: consolidations launched in high-debt environments are markedly more contractionary, and in more than half of the episodes in the sample the debt ratio was still higher three years after consolidation. Initial fiscal conditions matter more for outcomes than the choice between spending cuts and tax increases.
abstract_zh: 经合组织各国的公共债务正处于或接近历史高位，这加大了政府随时间推移恢复财政可持续性的压力。本专栏借鉴新的跨国证据表明，财政整顿的产出成本平均而言温和且短暂，难以发现持久性创伤。但平均值掩盖了一个关键的不对称性：在高债务环境下启动的整顿具有明显更强的紧缩效应，且在样本中超过一半的情形下，整顿三年后债务比率仍更高。初始财政状况对结果的影响大于削减支出与增税之间的选择。
authors: Luiz de Mello, Joao Tovar Jalles
title: Fiscal consolidation: Temporary costs versus lasting scars
title_zh: 财政整顿：暂时成本与持久伤痕

abstract: Financial crises routinely trigger sweeping overhauls of financial regulation, but whose interests do these reforms serve? Using data on financial policies in 88 democracies between 1973 and 2015, this column shows that leaders facing a binding term limit roll back financial liberalisation roughly three times more than leaders who can run again – but only in the wake of a financial crisis. The reforms they enact tend to favour incumbent banks over the general public. The effect is concentrated in countries where revolving doors between politics and finance are common, brings post-government career benefits to policymakers, but leads to no gains in banking stability.
abstract_zh: 金融危机 routinely 引发金融监管的全面改革，但这些改革服务于谁的利益？本文利用1973年至2015年间88个民主国家的金融政策数据表明，面临刚性任期限制的领导人逆转金融自由化的程度大约是能够竞选连任的领导人的三倍——但仅在金融危机之后。他们实施的改革往往偏向现有银行而非普通公众。这一效应集中在政治与金融之间“旋转门”现象普遍的国家，为政策制定者带来卸任后的职业收益，却未能在银行稳定性方面带来任何改善。
authors: Orkun Saka, Yuemei Ji, Clement Minaudier
title: Never let a good crisis go to waste: Term limits and banking reforms
title_zh: 切勿浪费一场好危机：任期限制与银行业改革

abstract: Studies of the revenue-expenditure nexus support each of its four hypotheses, as does the Turkish evidence. Most assume a time-invariant causal link, which is implausible for an economy exposed to frequent macroeconomic and policy shocks. This study examines changes in the direction of causality between real tax revenues and non-interest expenditures, applying the lag-augmented recursive evolving Granger causality test to monthly Turkish general budget data over 2006M1 to 2026M4. The results reveal repeated shifts: institutional separation until 2015, interrupted by spend-and-tax in 2011 and 2012, tax-and-spend from 2015, fiscal synchronization in 2017 and 2018, spend-and-tax during the 2019 slowdown, separation during the pandemic, tax-and-spend from mid-2021 and fiscal synchronization from early 2022 onward. These episodes coincide with phases of fiscal policy, from the electoral cycles and tax amnesties of the mid-2010s to the post-earthquake consolidation. Causality from revenue to expenditure in the mid-2010s and the final synchronization survive conditioning on inflation, industrial production and the exchange rate, whereas controlling for activity largely removes the 2017–2018 synchronization. The question of which side of the budget leads therefore has no time-invariant answer in Türkiye, and the answerable question is when each side leads.
abstract_zh: 关于财政收入与支出关系的各项研究支持其四种假说，土耳其的证据亦不例外。多数研究假定存在时不变的因果联系，而对于一个频繁遭受宏观经济与政策冲击的经济体而言，这一假定并不合理。本研究考察实际税收收入与非利息支出之间因果方向的变动，将滞后增广递归演化格兰杰因果检验应用于2006年1月至2026年4月的土耳其月度一般预算数据。结果揭示了反复出现的转变：2015年之前为制度性分离，2011年和2012年被“先支出后税收”打断，2015年起为“先税收后支出”，2017年和2018年为财政同步，2019年经济放缓期间为“先支出后税收”，疫情期间为分离，2021年中期起为“先税收后支出”，2022年初起为财政同步。这些阶段与财政政策的各个时期相吻合，从2010年代中期的选举周期和税收特赦到地震后的整顿。2010年代中期的收入对支出的因果性以及最终的同步性在控制通胀、工业生产和汇率后依然成立，而控制经济活动则基本消除了2017—2018年的同步性。因此，在土耳其，预算的哪一侧起主导作用这一问题没有时不变的答案，可回答的问题是每一侧何时起主导作用。
title: Revisiting the tax-spend nexus in Türkiye: evidence from time-varying Granger causality
title_zh: 重新审视土耳其的税收-支出关系：来自时变格兰杰因果关系的证据
